intake_facts: FY26 (ended 2026-01-25): revenue $215,938M, operating income $130,387M, net income $120,067M, diluted EPS $4.90, OCF $102,718M, capex $6,042M, SBC $6,386M.
Q1 FY27: revenue $81,616M, operating income $53,536M, other income net $16,367M, net income $58,321M, diluted EPS $2.39.
Q2 FY27 (ended 2026-07-26): revenue $96,221M (+105.9% y/y), gross margin 75.0%, operating income $63,734M (66.2%), net income $59,688M, diluted EPS $2.46, diluted shares 24,285M.
Q2 FY27 Data Center revenue $89,023M (+117% y/y, +18% q/q): Hyperscale $48,710M, AI Clouds/Industrial/Enterprise $40,313M (+138% y/y); Edge Computing $7,198M.
H1 FY27: revenue $177,837M, net income $118,010M, OCF $74,421M, capex $4,434M, SBC $3,954M, D&A $2,124M.
H1 FY27 net income includes $23,707M of non-cash gains from equity securities (~17% of $141,410M pre-tax income).
H1 FY27 working capital drag: AR -$24,590M, inventories -$10,204M, prepaid/other -$6,480M. AR $63,059M and inventories $31,575M at quarter end.
H1 FY27 capital deployment: purchases of equity securities $42,404M, buybacks $39,044M, dividends $6,290M, net debt issued $24,896M, Groq Inc. licence payment $2,944M (after $13,000M in FY26).

Balance sheet 2026-07-26: cash+marketable debt securities $56,586M, total debt $33,366M, net cash $23,220M; marketable equity $42,783M and non-marketable securities $51,157M ($93,940M excluded from net cash).
Shares outstanding 24,147M at 2026-07-26; 94M shares repurchased for $19,674M in Q2 FY27.
Commitments at 2026-07-26 total $366B: supply/capacity $279B, cloud service agreements $29B, data-center leases not commenced $25B, equity investments $25B, capex $8B.
Land/power/shell guarantees for AI cloud partners: $3,529M notional credit derivatives, $712M partner escrow. Public-company warrants received: $4,800M notional, $824M fair value.
Concentration: Q2 FY27 one direct customer 16% of revenue; H1 three at 16%/15%/13%; five direct customers were 22/14/13/11/10% of AR.

China: effectively foreclosed from the data-center compute market; H200 shipments <1% of Data Center revenue; $400M H200 charge in H1 FY27; China antitrust preliminary finding (2025-09-15) on the Mellanox conditions outstanding.
2026-09-02: definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for ~$11.9B plus up to ~$1.0B retention equity, expected to close H1 2027.
Q3 FY27 guidance (carried forward from the 2026-08-26 release): revenue $108B +/-2%, gross margin 74.0% +/-50bp, assuming no China Data Center compute revenue.
TTM to 2026-07-26: revenue $302,970M, net income $192,880M, OCF $134,360M, capex $7,354M, FCF $127,006M, SBC $7,241M, owner FCF $119,765M = $4.92 per diluted share.
Price 2026-09-17 close $219.34; market cap $5,326.7B; EV ~$5,303.5B; trailing P/E 27.6x; P/FCF 41.9x.
